==Description==
'''Transcendence''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|1,000}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

==Gallery==

{{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}}
<gallery>
Transcendence.gif|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020)
</gallery>
}}

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] is a reference to the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CyBNwZLVN3A ascended Spongebob] meme.
*The version 2 music used for '''Transcendence''' is a pitch up from the original music.
*This emote can be used to clip through walls and tight spaces.
**You can take advantage of this, as it can let you go to places that you are not allowed to go.
